messages.subject: Adding text to a plot
parts:
Good morning

How do I add text to a plot? I thought it would be geom_text, but that does not seem to be what I want, at least,
none of the examples are close to what I want to do.

Specifically, I want to add

r = 0.86

to a particular point in a plot.

TIA

Peter

messages.author: 4ddc99c6029ba75d
messages.subject: Re: Adding text to a plot
parts:
Like this?

qplot(x=rnorm(1:10),y=rnorm(1:10)) + annotate(geom="text",x=0.5,y=0.3,label="r=0.86")
